messages:
anya: quick q — can we include a tiny deterministic "replay artifact" on model ingest so bench diffs are reproducible across hosts?
sam: what do you mean by artifact? full corpora + RNG state would be huge.
anya: not that. small manifest: ~50 seed prompts (or hash), tokenizer snapshot id, model arch metadata, env fingerprint (GPU, driver), and seed + sampling params.
lucas: love it. helps postmortems. tradeoffs: storage growth and PII in prompts.
maria: we scrub benches today; make scrubbing enforced by lint in intake.
anya: example manifest:
```
version: "1"
prompts_hash: "sha256:..."
tokenizer_id: "tkn_v2"
env: "A100|driver:525.105"
seed: "42"
sampling: "temp=0.2,top_p=0.9"
compatibility_policy: "relaxed"
```
sam: store raw prompts encrypted in object store indexed by prompts_hash; keep manifest small in registry.
lucas: build a compact replay runner in smoketest infra that takes manifest + model-ref and emits canonical bench numbers; bench result ties to artifact id.
telemetry-bot: CI alert: bench-flakiness redwood-open/xyz variance 18% vs golden.
maria: motivation right there. artifact + runner lets ops rerun same env fingerprint to rule out infra noise.
anya: ops details: make artifacts optional for preview, required for Dedicated/Private. retention 90 days min.
sam: caution: pinning env too strictly causes churn when drivers update. propose weak fingerprint (major driver + arch) and runner exposes match_threshold.
lucas: add compatibility_policy: strict|relaxed|heuristic, default relaxed.
maria: add golden_prefix_hash (first 3 tokens hash) for quick smoke equality without storing full outputs.
anya: API changes: registry ingest accepts optional replay_artifact blob; intake lint validates; model metadata references artifact id.
lucas: rollout: 1) prototype manifest + runner, 2) require for internal models, 3) gradually for public gate.
maria: accept criteria: replays reproduce median within X% on matching fingerprint; lint rejects PII; v1 schema doc + CLI to generate artifacts.
anya: followup: docs + onboard-cli generate-artifact example. who will write RFC?
sam: I can draft RFC with schema, lint rules, retention; will drop draft by EOD tomorrow.
anya: great. recording INTAKE task.
dev-bot: deploybot: created INTAKE-789 implement artifact manifest + lint hook.
anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
